description: Honey-Can-Do SHF-01574 5-Tier Shelving System, Commercial Strength Adjustable Shelf, 18-inch by 42-inch by 72-inch, White. 800-pound per shelf capacity, when load is evenly distributed. NSF certified - for healthy living with a contemporary design, complements any decor. commercial grade finish, durable and withstands heavy use. Shelf Stands 72-inch Tall, 42-inch Wide, and 18-inch Deep. White storage shelving unit also comes in Black and Chrome. Create visible, accessible storage space instantly with Honey-Can-Do industrial shelving systems. Durable enough for the mudroom, garage, or commercial kitchen, our options span NSF-rated shelving for food equipment areas including refrigerators, freezers, and warewashing areas to heavy-duty shelving. Adjustable shelves and stackable components allow you to change the configuration as your storage needs evolve.
